slices.focus: Saira and Tom get married in a small Leeds registry-office ceremony
slices.summary: Saira and Tom marry in a small registry-office ceremony followed by a family meal with homemade cake. Saira feels relief more than excitement, realizing the simple version suited them better. She plans to pack away wedding bits, keep one honest photo, and enjoy ordinary life as a married couple.
open_loops: Wedding bits need to be packed into one box
One photo to print needs to be selected
Need to resist turning relief into a fresh burden
decisions: Saira and Tom got married in a small Leeds registry-office ceremony.
